items: Start with an audit of every location: check that each one is claimed, has current hours, photos and details, and has no duplicate or outdated profiles.
Fill in every Google Business Profile field and keep name, address and phone number identical across Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Bing and other directories, since small mismatches confuse Google.
Review rating, volume, recency and response rate all shape your map ranking, so automate replies across locations and send negative feedback to the right team quickly.
Give each location its own landing page with unique metadata, schema markup and an embedded map, then compare stores against each other to find under-performers.
Momos helps multi-location brands manage Google Business Profiles, reply to reviews with AI and fix listings issues across locations from one dashboard.
